name: De Nora India Limited
about: De Nora India Limited manufactures, sells, and services electrolytic products in India and internationally. The company offers anodes for horizontal and vertical plating lines in Printed Circuit Board, metal winning and refining, periodic pulse reverse plating, steel electrogalvanizing, production of chlorate and chlorine, and trivalent chrome plating; cathodes for production of caustic soda; and electrodes for concrete structure cathodic protection, offshore cathodic protection, pool electrochlorination, and steel structure protection. It is also involved in the manufacturing and recoating of anodes and cathodes for electrolytic processes in the chlor-alkali industry. In addition, it provides Sanilec and Seaclor offshore seawater electrochlorination systems. The company was formerly known as Titanor Components Limited and changed its name to De Nora India Limited in June 2007. De Nora India Limited was founded in 1988 and is based in Ponda, India. De Nora India Limited is a subsidiary of Oronzio De Nora International B.V.
